configurePresets.name: ci-linux-tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug (asserts on) at -O1, as TSan recommends (#524). Every target is instrumented, third-party included: at -O1 an uninstrumented COMDAT copy of an inline libstdc++ function (shared_ptr's _M_release) can win the link and hide an atomic from TSan, a false race (#532).
